name: hawksfold-skills
description: A growing collection of Claude Code skills.

plugins.name: challenge
plugins.description: Stress-test a plan, decision, or argument with a calibrated, balanced counter-view: surfaces the load-bearing assumption, triages objections by severity, and ends with the cheapest test to settle the question.

plugins.name: red-teaming-review
plugins.description: Two-round adversarial review of any output: attacks from six lenses with severity and confidence triage, tracks every finding's disposition, persists deferrals, and synthesizes the strongest version for the user to approve.
